name: The Silent Maiden
source:
After Emily Whitman suddenly dies with her last words being that she is engaged and part of a new family, her sister Jane travels to London to find out the truth.

[Description edited from [url=http://www.renai.us/game/silentm.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
艾米莉·惠特曼突然去世，临终前声称自己已经订婚，并成为一个新家庭的成员。她的姐姐简于是前往伦敦查明真相。

[简介编辑自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/silentm.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
